picks.detail: Capgemini’s ZF case describes a global RPA service. It is a relevant reference when several business units need a common operating model. In the RFP, ask which decisions the central team owns and which stay with a local process owner. Request one example of an automation rejected during discovery.

WeAreBrain describes automating supplier notifications and case updates for Truck Tyre Assist with ERP partner DooIT. Ask both who built the integration and who supports it. During evaluation, have the bidder trace a declined supplier request through reassignment and customer notification.

Slalom’s Genie case identifies the client, the support function and a rollout involving 180 agents. Ask the delivery lead which parts of a comparable bid cover training, queue configuration and post-launch support. Price those separately so a cheaper prototype is easy to spot alongside a fully staffed rollout.

methodology: Evaluate each firm as a bidder. Give finalists the same scenario and request documentary evidence for staffing, commercial scope and acceptance. Record an unanswered condition separately from a scored answer.
commercial_relationship: The publisher sells AI implementation services.
questions: Ask for named delivery leads, their allocation and any subcontracted work.
Request a reference in a similar operating environment. Ask the client what happened after go-live.
Require a sample statement of work with acceptance criteria, data handling and exit rights.
pricing: Ask for role-level rates, a milestone estimate and change-order terms. Normalize proposals to the same team size and time horizon before scoring cost.

firms.name: Accenture
firms.note: Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Request the proposed statement of work and ask the bidder to map each mandatory requirement to its contract clause.

firms.name: BCG
firms.note: Combines strategy and applied AI. Ask which executive sponsor and delivery lead would answer an escalation. Score the named team attending the bid review.

firms.name: Capgemini
firms.note: Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Request a reference for a program spanning multiple business units and ask what the client had to supply during rollout.

firms.name: Deloitte
firms.note: Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Give the bid team a sample data-quality exception. Score the proposed ownership and cost of remediation.

firms.name: IBM Consulting
firms.note: Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Request the responsibilities of the consulting team and software partners separately, including the support boundary.

firms.name: McKinsey QuantumBlack
firms.note: Describes a hybrid intelligence approach. Have the bid team show how an operations owner can challenge a model recommendation and record the ruling.

firms.name: Slalom
firms.note: Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Ask for the rollout lead to attend the reference interview. Compare promised training with what the named client received.

firms.name: AY Automate
firms.note: Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Ask which party owns the labeled examples and how the bidder will document reviewer overrides during acceptance. This provider publishes the guide.

firms.name: WeAreBrain
firms.note: Offers workflow automation and integration. Require a responsibility table for the agency and its ERP partner. Ask who handles incidents spanning both systems.

firms.name: LowCode Agency
firms.note: Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. For a low-code bid, request export rights, platform fees and access rules in the same commercial response.
